reports.text: PLS HELP. ROAD SURFACE IS SINKING AT ONE SPOT AND CRACKS KEEP APPEARING, REPAIRED SEVERAL TIMES NEAR MANDI. NOBODY IS COMING.
Sir, Hospital bus stop ke paas footpath pe kaai jami hai, hamesha geela lagta hai 60 din se. Jaldi bhejo koi.
Caller says somewhere in Market Area: tar keeps cracking and sagging at the same place for 41 days. Please send someone.
Namaste sir, Community hall ke paas 8th cross tank bund area par road ke kinare ghaas garmi mein bhi hari rehti hai, koi paani nahi deta 40 din se. - Venkat 9445134063
@CityWaterBoard Namaste sir, Govt school wali gali mein wahi gaddha baar baar ban jaata hai, bharne ke baad phir dhans jaata hai 72 din se. #waterleak
Caller says on Canal Rd: water coming very slowly in the taps. Pls check asap.
Issue: water problem | Location: 5 cross Indira Colony pe | Details: paani mein mitti aa rahi hai. - Joseph 9274185159
Respected sir, After the rain the drain is overflowing onto the road on 2nd cross gandhi nagar.
Water tnak ke bagal mein koi pipe se paudhon ko paani de raha hai, road pe aa raha hai. Bahut paani waste ho raha hai.
Caller says the ground beside the road has stayed damp, there is no stream but it never dries park avenue. Nobody is coming. - Meena 9706927743
Caller says soft wet ground near the road edge, no visible water, it does not dry in front of shiva temple for 1 hours. Also road is sinking and water is coming. Very urgent. - Joseph 9802482792
